item.title: 3F-Powered 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 was refurbished and modified before the current owner's acquisition in 2022. item.title: 1953 Buick Special 2-Door Riviera at No Reserve
item.description: This 1953 Buick Special two-door Riviera was refurbished in the late 1990s by a relative of the seller's spouse. Work included refinishing the body in light yellow and white, rebuilding the 263ci straight-eight, and reupholstering the cabin in gray patterned cloth. The car is equipped with a Dynaflow Drive automatic transmission, body-color steel wheels, whitewall tires, drum brakes, a banjo-style steering wheel, and a heater/defroster. item.title: 1972 Fiat 128 Rally
item.description: This 1972 Fiat 128 Rally was initially registered in Italy, where it was reportedly acquired by the current owner approximately three decades ago. Power is supplied by a Lampredi 1,290cc SOHC inline-four that has been outfitted with dual Weber carburetors, while shifting is via a four-speed manual transaxle. item.title: 1959 Ariel Square Four
item.description: This 1959 Ariel Square Four is equipped with a 997cc square-four paired with a four-speed transmission and is finished in brown with polished accents. The bike rides on 19" and 18" wire-spoke wheels and is further equipped with a shrouded telescopic fork, plunger shocks, drum brakes, a kick starter, a single overhead-valve cylinder head, a tan two-up seat, and both side and rear stands. item.description: This 1974 Porsche 914 was acquired by the seller in 2022 and was subsequently rebuilt and modified with steel fender flares, a 6.2L LS3 V8 crate engine, a six-speed manual transaxle, a Wavetrac limited-slip differential, and rack-and-pinion steering. item.title: 2015 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT Final Edition Roadster at No Reserve
item.description: This 2015 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT roadster is one of 350 Final Edition examples built to commemorate the end of the model’s production run. item.title: 1965 Chevrolet Corvette Coupe L76 327/365 4-Speed
item.description: This 1965 Chevrolet Corvette coupe was acquired by the selling dealer as a project in January 2025, and a refurbishment included removing the body from the frame and refinishing the car in maroon over maroon. The car is powered by a 327ci L76 V8 paired with a four-speed manual transmission. and further equipped with a Positraction differential, 15″ cast aluminum wheels, power-assisted four-wheel disc brakes, an AM/FM radio, chrome bumpers, and retractable headlights. item.title: 1971 Ferrari 365 GT 2+2
item.description: This 1971 Ferrari 365 GT 2+2 is one of approximately 800 examples built during three years of production. It is powered by a 4.4-liter Colombo V12 linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential, and it is finished in red over beige Connolly leather.
